title.en: Lost NC Medicaid in 2026? Your 90-Day SEP Options
title.es: Perdio Medicaid en NC en 2026? Opciones SEP de 90 Dias

description.en: Lost NC Medicaid in 2026? You have 90 days to enroll in ACA Marketplace coverage. Compare costs, appeal rights, and how to re-qualify for NC Medicaid.
description.es: Perdio NC Medicaid en 2026? Tiene 90 dias para inscribirse en el Mercado ACA. Compare costos, derechos de apelacion y como volver a calificar para NC Medicaid.

h1.en: Lost Your Medicaid in North Carolina? Here Are Your Next Steps
h1.es: Perdio su Medicaid en Carolina del Norte? Aqui Estan sus Proximos Pasos

subhero.en: You have 90 days from your NC Medicaid termination date to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan. You may also appeal the decision or re-apply for NC Medicaid if your income still qualifies.
subhero.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de NC Medicaid para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA. Tambien puede apelar la decision o volver a solicitar NC Medicaid si su ingreso aun califica.

heading.en: You have 90 days from your NC Medicaid termination date
heading.es: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha de terminacion de NC Medicaid

body.en: The 90-day Marketplace Special Enrollment Period starts the day your NC Medicaid coverage ends. For example, if your coverage ended June 1, 2026, your SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. Miss that window and you must wait until ACA Open Enrollment in November 2026, leaving a gap in coverage.
body.es: El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias del Mercado comienza el dia en que termina su cobertura de NC Medicaid. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termino el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026. Si pierde esa ventana, debera esperar hasta la Inscripcion Abierta ACA en noviembre de 2026.

label.en: NC Medicaid appeal deadline (varies by notice)
label.es: Fecha limite de apelacion NC Medicaid (varia segun aviso)

label.en: Re-apply for NC Medicaid if income drops (year-round)
label.es: Volver a solicitar NC Medicaid si ingreso baja (todo el ano)

quickAnswer.en: Losing NC Medicaid in 2026 gives you a 90-day Special Enrollment Period to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. North Carolina uses the federal Marketplace, so you apply at healthcare.gov. Your three options are: (1) appeal the NC Medicaid termination if it was due to a paperwork error or your income still qualifies at or below 138% FPL (approximately $22,025 for a single adult in 2026); (2) enroll in a subsidized ACA Marketplace plan if your income is between 100% and 400% FPL; or (3) re-apply for NC Medicaid at any time if your income drops back to the qualifying threshold. File your appeal AND apply for marketplace coverage at the same time so you are not left without coverage.
quickAnswer.es: Perder NC Medicaid en 2026 le da un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov. Sus tres opciones son: (1) apelar la terminacion de NC Medicaid si fue por un error de papeleo o su ingreso aun califica al 138% FPL (aproximadamente $22,025 para un adulto soltero en 2026); (2) inscribirse en un plan subsidiado del Mercado ACA si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL; o (3) volver a solicitar NC Medicaid en cualquier momento si su ingreso baja al nivel de elegibilidad. Presente su apelacion Y solicite cobertura del Mercado al mismo tiempo.

introParagraphs.en: NC Medicaid is the state's Medicaid managed care program, which expanded to cover most adults ages 19 to 64 in December 2023. In 2026, more North Carolinians face coverage loss than at any point since expansion launched, driven by two forces: the standard annual redetermination process and new federal requirements from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), signed July 4, 2025. The OBBBA added work requirements for expansion adults (ages 19 to 64 without a qualifying disability), with tracking beginning December 2026 and enforcement starting January 1, 2027. Separately, immigrant eligibility restrictions under the OBBBA take effect October 1, 2026, removing certain lawfully present non-citizen groups from NC Medicaid eligibility. If you received a termination notice, you are not alone. Between 2023 and 2025, more than 272,000 North Carolinians were disenrolled from Medicaid following the end of pandemic-era continuous coverage protections, and many re-enrolled after correcting documentation errors.
introParagraphs.es: NC Medicaid es el programa de atencion administrada de Medicaid del estado, que se expandio para cubrir a la mayoria de los adultos de 19 a 64 anos en diciembre de 2023. En 2026, mas nortecarolinanos enfrentan la perdida de cobertura que en cualquier otro momento desde que se lanzo la expansion, impulsada por dos fuerzas: el proceso estandar de redeterminacion anual y los nuevos requisitos federales de la Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act (OBBBA), firmada el 4 de julio de 2025. La OBBBA agrego requisitos de trabajo para los adultos de expansion (de 19 a 64 anos sin una discapacidad calificada), con seguimiento a partir de diciembre de 2026 y aplicacion a partir del 1 de enero de 2027. Por separado, las restricciones de elegibilidad de inmigrantes bajo la OBBBA entran en vigor el 1 de octubre de 2026. Si recibio un aviso de terminacion, no esta solo.

introParagraphs.en: Six steps guide you through the first 90 days after losing NC Medicaid: how to appeal your termination, how to apply for ACA Marketplace coverage through healthcare.gov before your 90-day Special Enrollment Period closes, and how 2026 subsidy rules affect your costs. The ACA subsidy cliff returned for 2026 after enhanced premium tax credits from ARPA and the Inflation Reduction Act expired January 1, 2026. Households above 400% FPL ($63,840 for a single person in 2026) no longer get premium tax credits, but most people losing NC Medicaid are far below that threshold and will qualify for significant subsidies. Check the Medicaid income limits to confirm your eligibility before deciding your next step, and use the ACA income limits to estimate your marketplace subsidy.
introParagraphs.es: Seis pasos le guian a traves de los primeros 90 dias despues de perder NC Medicaid: como apelar su terminacion, como solicitar cobertura del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov antes de que cierre su Periodo de Inscripcion Especial de 90 dias, y como las reglas de subsidios de 2026 afectan sus costos. El acantilado de subsidios ACA regreso para 2026 despues de que expiraron los creditos fiscales de prima mejorados el 1 de enero de 2026. Los hogares por encima del 400% FPL ($63,840 para una sola persona en 2026) ya no reciben creditos fiscales de prima, pero la mayoria de las personas que pierden NC Medicaid estan muy por debajo de ese umbral. Verifique los limites de ingresos de Medicaid para confirmar su elegibilidad y use los limites de ingresos del ACA para estimar su subsidio del mercado.

name.en: Read your NC Medicaid termination notice the same day it arrives
name.es: Lea su aviso de terminacion de NC Medicaid el mismo dia que llega

text.en: Your termination notice states the reason for loss, the coverage end date, and your appeal deadline. Common reasons in 2026 include failure to return the annual renewal form, a reported income change, missing documentation, or the new OBBBA immigrant eligibility restrictions. Record your exact coverage end date because your 90-day marketplace SEP window starts from that date.
text.es: Su aviso de terminacion indica la razon de la perdida, la fecha de fin de cobertura y la fecha limite de apelacion. Las razones comunes en 2026 incluyen no devolver el formulario de renovacion anual, un cambio de ingreso reportado, documentacion faltante, o las nuevas restricciones de elegibilidad de inmigrantes bajo OBBBA. Registre su fecha exacta de fin de cobertura porque su ventana SEP de 90 dias del mercado comienza desde esa fecha.

name.en: File your NC Medicaid appeal if you believe the termination was wrong
name.es: Presente su apelacion de NC Medicaid si cree que la terminacion fue incorrecta

text.en: Submit your appeal through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov or contact your county Department of Social Services. Most NC Medicaid termination notices give you 30 days to request a fair hearing. If you appeal before your coverage end date, NC Medicaid must continue your coverage while the appeal is pending. Winning an appeal reinstates your NC Medicaid retroactively at no cost to you.
text.es: Presente su apelacion a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov o contacte a su Departamento de Servicios Sociales del condado. La mayoria de los avisos de terminacion de NC Medicaid le dan 30 dias para solicitar una audiencia justa. Si apela antes de la fecha de fin de cobertura, NC Medicaid debe continuar su cobertura mientras la apelacion esta pendiente.

name.en: Apply for ACA Marketplace coverage at healthcare.gov within 90 days
name.es: Solicite cobertura del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov dentro de 90 dias

text.en: North Carolina uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov, not a state exchange. Select the loss-of-Medicaid Special Enrollment Period when prompted. Enter your projected 2026 household income using Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI). If your income is between 100% and 400% FPL ($15,960 to $63,840 for a single person), you qualify for premium tax credits that can reduce your monthly premium to $0 to $200 per month for a Silver plan.
text.es: Carolina del Norte usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov, no un intercambio estatal. Seleccione el Periodo de Inscripcion Especial por perdida de Medicaid cuando se le solicite. Ingrese su ingreso familiar proyectado para 2026 usando el Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI). Si su ingreso esta entre el 100% y el 400% FPL ($15,960 a $63,840 para una sola persona), califica para creditos fiscales de prima.

name.en: Compare Silver plans for Cost Sharing Reductions if your income is under 250% FPL
name.es: Compare planes Silver para Reducciones de Costo Compartido si su ingreso es menor del 250% FPL

text.en: Silver plans with Cost Sharing Reductions (CSRs) are only available through the ACA Marketplace and only for enrollees under 250% FPL (approximately $39,900 for a single person in 2026). CSR Silver plans cut your deductible and out-of-pocket maximum dramatically, often to $500 to $1,500, compared to $8,000 to $10,600 on a standard Silver or Bronze plan. Enroll in a Silver plan to access CSRs, even if a Bronze plan has a lower premium.
text.es: Los planes Silver con Reducciones de Costo Compartido (CSR) solo estan disponibles a traves del Mercado ACA y solo para inscritos con ingresos inferiores al 250% FPL (aproximadamente $39,900 para una sola persona en 2026). Los planes Silver CSR reducen drasticamente su deducible y maximo de gastos de bolsillo, a menudo a $500 a $1,500, en comparacion con $8,000 a $10,600 en un plan Silver o Bronze estandar.

name.en: Check whether your children still qualify for NC Medicaid or NC Health Choice (CHIP)
name.es: Verifique si sus hijos aun califican para NC Medicaid o NC Health Choice (CHIP)

text.en: NC Health Choice is North Carolina's CHIP program covering uninsured children through age 18 at incomes up to 211% FPL (approximately $63,700 for a family of four in 2026). Even if you lose NC Medicaid, your children may still qualify for NC Health Choice. Apply year-round through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov or at your county Department of Social Services. CHIP enrollment is not subject to the 90-day SEP window.
text.es: NC Health Choice es el programa CHIP de Carolina del Norte que cubre a ninos no asegurados hasta los 18 anos con ingresos de hasta el 211% FPL (aproximadamente $63,700 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). Incluso si pierde NC Medicaid, sus hijos pueden calificar para NC Health Choice. Solicite todo el ano a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov.

name.en: Re-apply for NC Medicaid any time your income drops back to 138% FPL
name.es: Vuelva a solicitar NC Medicaid cuando su ingreso baje al 138% FPL

text.en: NC Medicaid enrollment is year-round for eligible applicants. If your income drops back to or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of four in 2026) due to job loss, reduced hours, or other income changes, re-apply through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov or call 1-888-245-0179. A new application typically processes within 45 days. NC Medicaid provides comprehensive benefits including doctor visits, hospitalizations, mental health care, and prescription drugs at no or minimal cost.
text.es: La inscripcion en NC Medicaid es todo el ano para solicitantes elegibles. Si su ingreso baja al 138% FPL ($22,025 individual, $45,540 familia de cuatro en 2026) debido a perdida de empleo, reduccion de horas u otros cambios de ingreso, vuelva a solicitar a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov o llame al 1-888-245-0179.

intro.en: The most damaging mistakes North Carolinians make after losing NC Medicaid in 2026:
intro.es: Los errores mas daninos que los nortecarolinanos cometen despues de perder NC Medicaid en 2026:

items.en: Waiting past the 90-day SEP window. If you miss the 90-day marketplace enrollment period after losing NC Medicaid, you cannot get ACA coverage until November Open Enrollment, leaving months without insurance.
items.es: Esperar mas alla de la ventana SEP de 90 dias. Si pierde el periodo de inscripcion de 90 dias del mercado despues de perder NC Medicaid, no puede obtener cobertura ACA hasta la Inscripcion Abierta de noviembre.

items.en: Not filing an appeal. Many NC Medicaid terminations in 2026 stem from administrative errors, not actual ineligibility. Approximately 40% of terminations during the 2023 to 2025 unwinding period were procedural rather than income-based.
items.es: No presentar una apelacion. Muchas terminaciones de NC Medicaid en 2026 se deben a errores administrativos, no a inelegibilidad real. Aproximadamente el 40% de las terminaciones durante el periodo de desenrollamiento de 2023 a 2025 fueron procedimentales.

items.en: Reporting last year's income instead of projected 2026 income. The ACA Marketplace calculates subsidies on your projected annual Modified Adjusted Gross Income for the current year, not prior-year income from a tax return.
items.es: Reportar los ingresos del ano pasado en lugar de los ingresos proyectados para 2026. El Mercado ACA calcula los subsidios en base a su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado anual proyectado para el ano en curso.

items.en: Enrolling in Bronze instead of Silver when income is below 250% FPL. Cost Sharing Reduction plans are only available on Silver tier plans. A Bronze plan at the same or lower premium may have a $6,000 to $10,600 deductible, while a CSR Silver plan may have a $500 deductible.
items.es: Inscribirse en Bronze en lugar de Silver cuando el ingreso esta por debajo del 250% FPL. Los planes de Reduccion de Costo Compartido solo estan disponibles en planes Silver. Un plan Bronze puede tener un deducible de $6,000 a $10,600, mientras que un plan Silver CSR puede tener un deducible de $500.

items.en: Forgetting to separately enroll children in NC Health Choice. NC Health Choice (CHIP) covers children through age 18 at incomes up to 211% FPL. Even if adults in the household lose NC Medicaid, children often still qualify.
items.es: Olvidar inscribir a los ninos por separado en NC Health Choice. NC Health Choice (CHIP) cubre a ninos hasta los 18 anos con ingresos de hasta el 211% FPL. Incluso si los adultos del hogar pierden NC Medicaid, los ninos a menudo aun califican.

items.en: Assuming the OBBBA work requirement is already in effect. Work requirement tracking begins December 2026 and enforcement starts January 1, 2027. A termination notice in 2026 citing work requirements before that date should be appealed immediately.
items.es: Asumir que el requisito de trabajo de OBBBA ya esta en vigor. El seguimiento de los requisitos de trabajo comienza en diciembre de 2026 y la aplicacion comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. Un aviso de terminacion en 2026 que cite requisitos de trabajo antes de esa fecha debe apelarse de inmediato.

heading.en: Why NC Medicaid Terminations Are Rising in 2026
heading.es: Por que las terminaciones de NC Medicaid estan aumentando en 2026

paragraphs.en: NC Medicaid expanded in December 2023, bringing approximately 600,000 additional North Carolinians into coverage. Annual redeterminations for this expansion population began in 2024 and continue through 2026. North Carolina's annual redetermination process reviews your income, household size, and eligibility documentation every 12 months. Renewals can be triggered by changes reported by the Social Security Administration, the IRS, or employer data exchanges, even if your income has not changed significantly. If the state sends a renewal form and it is not returned within the deadline, NC Medicaid automatically terminates coverage regardless of whether your income still qualifies.
paragraphs.es: NC Medicaid se expandio en diciembre de 2023, incorporando aproximadamente 600,000 nortecarolinanos adicionales a la cobertura. Las redeterminaciones anuales para esta poblacion de expansion comenzaron en 2024 y continuan hasta 2026. El proceso de redeterminacion anual de Carolina del Norte revisa su ingreso, tamano del hogar y documentacion de elegibilidad cada 12 meses. Las renovaciones pueden desencadenarse por cambios reportados por la Administracion del Seguro Social, el IRS o intercambios de datos del empleador.

paragraphs.en: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act adds two new 2026 to 2027 termination triggers. Starting October 1, 2026, certain immigrant populations that were previously eligible lose coverage under the new federal restrictions. Starting January 1, 2027, expansion adults ages 19 to 64 without qualifying disabilities must complete 80 hours per month of work or qualifying activities to retain NC Medicaid. Exemptions include pregnant individuals, people with documented medical conditions, full-time students, caregivers of dependents under age 6, and American Indian and Alaska Native tribal members. Tracking of work activities begins December 2026, meaning beneficiaries should start documenting qualifying activities now to avoid a coverage gap at enforcement.
paragraphs.es: La Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act agrega dos nuevos desencadenantes de terminacion para 2026 a 2027. A partir del 1 de octubre de 2026, ciertas poblaciones de inmigrantes que antes eran elegibles pierden cobertura. A partir del 1 de enero de 2027, los adultos de expansion de 19 a 64 anos sin discapacidades calificadas deben completar 80 horas al mes de trabajo o actividades calificadas para conservar NC Medicaid. Las exenciones incluyen personas embarazadas, personas con condiciones medicas documentadas, estudiantes a tiempo completo y cuidadores de dependientes menores de 6 anos.

heading.en: NC Medicaid vs ACA Marketplace: Which Fits Your 2026 Income?
heading.es: NC Medicaid vs Mercado ACA: Cual se adapta a sus ingresos de 2026?

paragraphs.en: NC Medicaid provides free, comprehensive coverage with no monthly premiums and minimal copayments (typically $1 to $4 per service) for adults at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. For 2026, that threshold is $22,025 per year for a single adult and $45,540 for a family of four. NC Medicaid covers doctor visits, hospitalizations, mental health and substance use disorder treatment, prescription drugs (with a preferred drug list), dental care for adults (preventive and emergency services), and vision care. The ACA Marketplace fills the gap for North Carolinians above 138% FPL. Premium tax credits apply for incomes between 100% and 400% FPL. At 150% FPL ($23,940 single in 2026), benchmark Silver plan premiums after tax credits typically range from $0 to $30 per month in North Carolina. At 250% FPL ($39,900 single in 2026), typical Silver plan premiums after credits run $60 to $150 per month. Above 400% FPL ($63,840 single in 2026), the subsidy cliff means no premium tax credits are available in 2026.
paragraphs.es: NC Medicaid proporciona cobertura integral gratuita sin primas mensuales y copagos minimos (tipicamente $1 a $4 por servicio) para adultos al 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal o menos. Para 2026, ese umbral es $22,025 por ano para un adulto soltero y $45,540 para una familia de cuatro. El Mercado ACA llena el vacio para los nortecarolinanos por encima del 138% FPL. Los creditos fiscales de prima se aplican para ingresos entre el 100% y el 400% FPL.

heading.en: Documents You Need to Appeal NC Medicaid or Enroll in the Marketplace in 2026
heading.es: Documentos que necesita para apelar NC Medicaid o inscribirse en el Mercado en 2026

paragraphs.en: Three documents stop most NC Medicaid appeals in their tracks when missing: the original termination notice (which states the reason and your rights), proof of current income, and proof of NC residency. For ACA Marketplace enrollment, the healthcare.gov system requires you to verify the loss-of-coverage qualifying life event, which means uploading your NC Medicaid termination letter or a state-issued confirmation of the coverage end date. Gather all six items below before starting your appeal or marketplace application to avoid processing delays.
paragraphs.es: Tres documentos detienen la mayoria de las apelaciones de NC Medicaid cuando faltan: el aviso de terminacion original (que indica la razon y sus derechos), prueba de ingreso actual y prueba de residencia en NC. Para la inscripcion en el Mercado ACA, el sistema de healthcare.gov requiere que verifique el evento calificador de vida de perdida de cobertura.

list.en: NC Medicaid termination letter or notice of action (required for SEP verification at healthcare.gov)
list.es: Carta de terminacion de NC Medicaid o aviso de accion (requerido para verificacion SEP en healthcare.gov)

list.en: Proof of current income: recent pay stubs (last 30 days), unemployment award letter, or self-employment profit and loss statement
list.es: Prueba de ingreso actual: talones de pago recientes (ultimos 30 dias), carta de beneficio de desempleo o estado de ganancias y perdidas de trabajo por cuenta propia

list.en: Social Security numbers for all household members applying for coverage
list.es: Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura

list.en: Proof of NC residency: utility bill, lease agreement, or mortgage statement dated within the last 60 days
list.es: Prueba de residencia en NC: factura de servicios publicos, contrato de arrendamiento o estado de cuenta hipotecario fechado en los ultimos 60 dias

list.en: Immigration documents if applicable (green card, visa, or other status documentation for lawfully present non-citizens)
list.es: Documentos de inmigracion si aplica (tarjeta verde, visa u otra documentacion de estatus para no ciudadanos legalmente presentes)

list.en: Birth certificates or adoption records for any children being added to the new plan
list.es: Actas de nacimiento o registros de adopcion para cualquier nino que se agregue al nuevo plan

heading.en: NC Medicaid Income Limits by Household Size, 2026
heading.es: Limites de ingresos de NC Medicaid por tamano de hogar, 2026

paragraphs.en: North Carolina Medicaid expansion covers adults ages 19 to 64 at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level. NC DHHS updates its income tables on April 1 each year when the federal HHS poverty guidelines are finalized. The thresholds below reflect the post-April 1, 2026 guidelines. Pregnant individuals qualify at a higher threshold (211% FPL for most categories). Children qualify through NC Health Choice at incomes up to 211% FPL. Non-expansion categories (elderly, blind, disabled adults, and certain caretaker relatives) may have different thresholds. Verify at medicaid.ncdhhs.gov or through NC ePASS for your specific household.
paragraphs.es: La expansion de NC Medicaid cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 anos al 138% del Nivel de Pobreza Federal o menos. NC DHHS actualiza sus tablas de ingresos el 1 de abril de cada ano. Los umbrales a continuacion reflejan las pautas posteriores al 1 de abril de 2026. Las personas embarazadas califican con un umbral mas alto (211% FPL). Los ninos califican a traves de NC Health Choice con ingresos de hasta el 211% FPL.

en: Missing the 90-day Marketplace SEP window after NC Medicaid termination: application submitted after Day 90 from the coverage end date
Uploading insufficient proof of NC Medicaid loss (marketplace requires the actual termination letter, not just a verbal statement or screenshot of an online portal)
Reporting prior-year income from a tax return instead of projected 2026 Modified Adjusted Gross Income for subsidy eligibility
Applying through a broker or navigator without first verifying the SEP qualifying event code (use 'loss of Medicaid or CHIP' not generic 'loss of coverage')
Missing the NC Medicaid fair hearing deadline (typically 30 days from the termination notice date) and losing appeal rights
es: Perder la ventana SEP del Mercado de 90 dias despues de la terminacion de NC Medicaid: solicitud presentada despues del dia 90 desde la fecha de fin de cobertura
Subir prueba insuficiente de la perdida de NC Medicaid (el mercado requiere la carta de terminacion real, no solo una declaracion verbal o captura de pantalla)
Reportar ingresos del ano anterior de una declaracion de impuestos en lugar del Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado proyectado para 2026
Solicitar a traves de un corredor o navegador sin verificar primero el codigo de evento calificador SEP (use 'perdida de Medicaid o CHIP' no 'perdida de cobertura' generica)
No cumplir con el plazo de audiencia justa de NC Medicaid (tipicamente 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso de terminacion) y perder los derechos de apelacion

stateRules.rule: NC Medicaid expanded to adults ages 19 to 64 at or below 138% FPL in December 2023. Annual redetermination required. OBBBA work requirements (80 hours/month) begin tracking December 2026 with enforcement January 1, 2027. Immigrant eligibility restrictions begin October 1, 2026.
NC Health Choice (CHIP) covers uninsured children through age 18 at incomes up to 211% FPL. Year-round enrollment through NC ePASS (epass.nc.gov) or county DSS. Not subject to ACA SEP deadlines.
North Carolina uses healthcare.gov (the federal Marketplace); there is no state-run exchange. Marketplace SEP for loss of Medicaid is 90 days from coverage end date per federal CMS rules.

heading.en: NC Medicaid vs Marketplace vs COBRA After Losing Coverage in 2026
heading.es: NC Medicaid vs Mercado vs COBRA Despues de Perder Cobertura en 2026

body.en: NC Medicaid delivers the most comprehensive benefits at zero cost for North Carolinians at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 single, $45,540 family of four in 2026). Copayments are nominal ($1 to $4 per service for most adults), and the program covers everything from primary care and specialty visits to mental health treatment, substance use disorder services, dental care, vision, and prescription drugs through the NC Medicaid Preferred Drug List. ACA Marketplace plans on healthcare.gov are the next tier for North Carolinians whose income rises above 138% FPL. Silver plans with Cost Sharing Reductions (CSRs) are the best choice for incomes under 250% FPL ($39,900 single) because CSRs can cut the deductible from $8,000 to as low as $500 and reduce out-of-pocket maximums substantially. Premium tax credits bring monthly costs to $0 to $150 for most Silver CSR enrollees in North Carolina at 150% to 250% FPL. COBRA is a last resort for the narrow subset who recently had job-based coverage alongside NC Medicaid (rare) and need to maintain a specific specialist relationship. COBRA charges 102% of the full group premium, typically $500 to $2,000 per month for an individual, far exceeding what a subsidized ACA plan would cost. The decision matrix for most North Carolinians losing NC Medicaid: appeal first, re-apply if income qualifies, then enroll in a Silver CSR Marketplace plan as a safety net within the 90-day SEP window.
body.es: NC Medicaid entrega los beneficios mas completos a cero costo para los nortecarolinanos al 138% FPL o menos ($22,025 individual, $45,540 familia de cuatro en 2026). Los copagos son nominales ($1 a $4 por servicio para la mayoria de adultos). Los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov son el siguiente nivel para nortecarolinanos cuyos ingresos superan el 138% FPL. Los planes Silver con Reducciones de Costo Compartido (CSR) son la mejor opcion para ingresos inferiores al 250% FPL ($39,900 individual) porque los CSR pueden reducir el deducible a tan solo $500. COBRA es un ultimo recurso para la estrecha subpoblacion que recientemente tenia cobertura laboral junto con NC Medicaid y necesita mantener una relacion especifica con un especialista.

en.question: How long do I have to get new coverage after losing NC Medicaid?
en.answer: You have 90 days from the date your NC Medicaid coverage ends to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan through healthcare.gov. This is longer than the standard 60-day SEP for other coverage losses. For example, if your coverage ended June 1, 2026, your SEP window runs through August 30, 2026. NC Medicaid itself can be re-applied for year-round if your income drops back to 138% FPL or below. NC Health Choice (CHIP) for children is also year-round enrollment.

en.question: What is the SEP window after losing NC Medicaid and when does it start?
en.answer: The Marketplace Special Enrollment Period for loss of Medicaid is 90 days. The 90-day clock starts on the day your NC Medicaid coverage ends, not the day you receive the termination notice. If you were notified late or did not receive notice, healthcare.gov may extend your SEP. Plans enrolled during this 90-day SEP start coverage on the first day of the month after you complete enrollment. File your marketplace application as early as possible to avoid a gap.

en.question: Can I appeal my NC Medicaid termination instead of switching to a Marketplace plan?
en.answer: Yes. NC Medicaid termination notices include fair hearing rights. You typically have 30 days from the notice date to request a fair hearing through NC DHHS or your county Department of Social Services. If you appeal before your coverage end date, NC Medicaid must continue your coverage while the appeal is pending. Approximately 40% of Medicaid terminations during the 2023 to 2025 unwinding period were due to administrative or documentation errors, not actual income changes. Appealing is always worth considering before switching to a paid Marketplace plan.

en.question: Do I qualify for NC Medicaid if I lose my job in North Carolina in 2026?
en.answer: Yes, if your projected 2026 annual household income is at or below 138% FPL. For a single adult, that is $22,025 per year in 2026. For a family of four, it is $45,540. NC Medicaid is year-round enrollment with no SEP deadline. Apply through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov or call 1-888-245-0179. Processing typically takes up to 45 days, so apply immediately after income drops. If your income is above 138% FPL, check ACA Marketplace plans at healthcare.gov where subsidy-reduced plans may cost $0 to $200 per month.

en.question: What is NC Health Choice and do my children qualify after I lose NC Medicaid?
en.answer: NC Health Choice is North Carolina's CHIP program for uninsured children through age 18. Children qualify at incomes up to 211% FPL (approximately $63,700 for a family of four in 2026). Enrollment is year-round and not subject to the 90-day Marketplace SEP deadline. Even if you as an adult lose NC Medicaid because your income rose above 138% FPL, your children may still qualify for NC Health Choice. Apply through NC ePASS at epass.nc.gov, through a local navigator, or at your county Department of Social Services.

en.question: What do the OBBBA work requirements mean for NC Medicaid in 2026?
en.answer: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act added work requirements for expansion adults (ages 19 to 64 without qualifying disabilities) enrolled in NC Medicaid. Activity tracking begins December 2026, and enforcement with coverage loss begins January 1, 2027. The requirement is 80 hours per month of work, work training, volunteering, or education. Exemptions include pregnant individuals, people with medical conditions preventing work, caregivers of dependents under age 6, full-time students, and American Indian and Alaska Native tribal members. If you receive a termination notice in 2026 citing work requirements before January 2027, appeal it immediately.

en.question: How do I apply for ACA Marketplace coverage after losing NC Medicaid?
en.answer: North Carolina uses the federal Marketplace at healthcare.gov, not a state exchange. Go to healthcare.gov, create or log into your account, and click 'report a life change.' Select 'lost Medicaid or CHIP coverage' as your qualifying event and enter the date your NC Medicaid ended. Enter your 2026 projected household Modified Adjusted Gross Income (MAGI). The system will show available plans in your county with subsidy estimates. If your income is under 250% FPL, compare Silver plans first for Cost Sharing Reductions. Submit your application and upload your NC Medicaid termination letter when prompted. Coverage starts the first of the month after enrollment.

en.question: What if I miss the 90-day SEP window after losing NC Medicaid?
en.answer: If you miss the 90-day window, your options narrow significantly. You cannot enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan until the 2027 Open Enrollment Period, which runs November 1 through January 15, 2027 for coverage starting January 1, 2027. Exceptions exist if another qualifying life event occurs (marriage, birth, move to a new state, loss of job-based coverage). NC Medicaid itself is year-round, so if your income drops below 138% FPL at any point, apply immediately through NC ePASS. Children can still enroll in NC Health Choice year-round regardless of the adult SEP window.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo tengo para obtener nueva cobertura despues de perder NC Medicaid?
es.answer: Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha en que termina su cobertura de NC Medicaid para inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA a traves de healthcare.gov. Esto es mas largo que el SEP estandar de 60 dias para otras perdidas de cobertura. Por ejemplo, si su cobertura termino el 1 de junio de 2026, su ventana SEP corre hasta el 30 de agosto de 2026. NC Medicaid en si puede solicitarse todo el ano si su ingreso baja al 138% FPL o menos. NC Health Choice (CHIP) para ninos tambien tiene inscripcion todo el ano.

es.question: Cual es la ventana SEP despues de perder NC Medicaid y cuando comienza?
es.answer: El Periodo de Inscripcion Especial del Mercado por perdida de Medicaid es de 90 dias. El reloj de 90 dias comienza el dia en que termina su cobertura de NC Medicaid, no el dia en que recibe el aviso de terminacion. Los planes inscritos durante este SEP de 90 dias comienzan la cobertura el primer dia del mes despues de completar la inscripcion. Presente su solicitud del mercado lo antes posible para evitar una brecha de cobertura.

es.question: Puedo apelar mi terminacion de NC Medicaid en lugar de cambiar a un plan del Mercado?
es.answer: Si. Los avisos de terminacion de NC Medicaid incluyen derechos de audiencia justa. Generalmente tiene 30 dias desde la fecha del aviso para solicitar una audiencia justa a traves de NC DHHS o su Departamento de Servicios Sociales del condado. Si apela antes de la fecha de fin de cobertura, NC Medicaid debe continuar su cobertura mientras la apelacion esta pendiente. Aproximadamente el 40% de las terminaciones de Medicaid durante el periodo 2023 a 2025 fueron debidas a errores administrativos o de documentacion. Apelar siempre vale la pena considerarlo antes de cambiar a un plan del Mercado de pago.

es.question: Califico para NC Medicaid si pierdo mi trabajo en Carolina del Norte en 2026?
es.answer: Si, si su ingreso anual proyectado del hogar para 2026 esta al 138% FPL o menos. Para un adulto soltero, eso es $22,025 por ano en 2026. Para una familia de cuatro, es $45,540. NC Medicaid tiene inscripcion todo el ano sin fecha limite SEP. Solicite a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov o llame al 1-888-245-0179. Si su ingreso esta por encima del 138% FPL, verifique los planes del Mercado ACA en healthcare.gov donde los planes con subsidios pueden costar de $0 a $200 al mes.

es.question: Que es NC Health Choice y califican mis hijos despues de que pierdo NC Medicaid?
es.answer: NC Health Choice es el programa CHIP de Carolina del Norte para ninos no asegurados hasta los 18 anos. Los ninos califican con ingresos de hasta el 211% FPL (aproximadamente $63,700 para una familia de cuatro en 2026). La inscripcion es todo el ano y no esta sujeta al plazo SEP del Mercado de 90 dias. Incluso si usted como adulto pierde NC Medicaid porque su ingreso supero el 138% FPL, sus hijos pueden seguir calificando para NC Health Choice. Solicite a traves de NC ePASS en epass.nc.gov.

es.question: Que significan los requisitos de trabajo de OBBBA para NC Medicaid en 2026?
es.answer: La Ley One Big Beautiful Bill Act agrego requisitos de trabajo para adultos de expansion (de 19 a 64 anos sin discapacidades calificadas) inscritos en NC Medicaid. El seguimiento de actividades comienza en diciembre de 2026, y la aplicacion con perdida de cobertura comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. El requisito es 80 horas al mes de trabajo, capacitacion laboral, voluntariado o educacion. Las exenciones incluyen personas embarazadas, personas con condiciones medicas, cuidadores de dependientes menores de 6 anos, estudiantes a tiempo completo y miembros de tribus de Indios Americanos. Si recibe un aviso de terminacion en 2026 citando requisitos de trabajo antes de enero de 2027, apelelo de inmediato.

es.question: Como solicito cobertura del Mercado ACA despues de perder NC Medicaid?
es.answer: Carolina del Norte usa el Mercado federal en healthcare.gov, no un intercambio estatal. Vaya a healthcare.gov, cree o inicie sesion en su cuenta, y haga clic en 'reportar un cambio de vida.' Seleccione 'perdi cobertura de Medicaid o CHIP' como su evento calificador e ingrese la fecha en que termino su NC Medicaid. Ingrese su Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado (MAGI) proyectado para el hogar para 2026. Si su ingreso es inferior al 250% FPL, compare los planes Silver primero para las Reducciones de Costo Compartido. Suba su carta de terminacion de NC Medicaid cuando se le solicite. La cobertura comienza el primero del mes despues de la inscripcion.

es.question: Que pasa si pierdo la ventana SEP de 90 dias despues de perder NC Medicaid?
es.answer: Si pierde la ventana de 90 dias, sus opciones se reducen significativamente. No puede inscribirse en un plan del Mercado ACA hasta el Periodo de Inscripcion Abierta 2027, que corre del 1 de noviembre al 15 de enero de 2027 para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. Existen excepciones si ocurre otro evento calificador de vida (matrimonio, nacimiento, mudanza a otro estado). NC Medicaid en si es todo el ano, por lo que si su ingreso baja por debajo del 138% FPL en cualquier momento, solicite de inmediato a traves de NC ePASS. Los ninos pueden inscribirse en NC Health Choice todo el ano independientemente de la ventana SEP para adultos.
